evidence.quote: You must supply an API key in a parameter named 'key'. As of 10 November 2025, all users need an API key to access the Altmetric Details Page API.
You can request API access from our support team ... Contact us to request a demo or more details on how to get access
To obtain access, register for an API key at https://www.altmetric.com/solutions/altmetric-api/
If you find that you frequently hit the rate limit then you might want to consider throttling your requests or purchasing a commercial API key.

not_established: Cost (no pricing page; docs mention a commercial key and a subscription but no free tier is stated); numeric rate limits (docs only say to read X-HourlyRateLimit-Limit and X-DailyRateLimit-Limit headers; meta.json recorded 720 hourly and 1200 daily on the 403 response, but that is not in a text snapshot and the docs text predates the mandatory key); data license (docs Licensing and Reasonable Use pages returned 404 at the guessed URLs); bulk access.
